approval_gate: G0; no stimulus, simulation, formal run, coverage collection or new verification code until named G0 approval.

functional_coverage.target: Every active in-scope requirement and protocol clause has a passing independently checked test for every applicable configuration/dimension in scope_matrix.json.
functional_coverage.closure: All applicable obligation IDs must be observed or separately dispositioned by the designer; no inferred closure from code coverage.

assertion_coverage.target: Every planned safety/liveness assertion is activated and reaches both its intended antecedent and outcome; vacuous proofs are reported, not credited.
assertion_coverage.fairness: Liveness claims require explicit eventual READY/response/ACK fairness. No finite completion is claimed under the HDS no-timeout missing-ACK contract.

mutation_coverage.target: Run checker-focused and selected RTL fault mutations; report killed, survived, invalid, and equivalent mutants separately.
mutation_coverage.policy: No production RTL edits; mutations run in disposable copies and every mutant has a retained diff and replay command.

code_coverage.tool: Verilator 5.053 candidate; exact binary hash/version/options captured in qualification and run manifests.
code_coverage.metric_note: Expression coverage is the user-approved replacement for condition coverage; it is not labeled condition coverage and is reported as its own metric.
code_coverage.denominator: Exact active TOP filelist closure in active_rtl_source_scope.json: at least 119 confirmed threshold files (35 VLSIT-created/generated and 84 active modified licensed-source copies). Measure full HDL content of each such file, not only changed diff lines. There are 343 additional active source files under third_party paths; those are only excluded after comparison to exact pinned upstream revisions. Any local difference is added to the threshold. Two verification-support sources are outside DUT coverage.
code_coverage.aggregation: Report each metric independently by configuration and as a set union across applicable configurations. Never average percentages. A configuration-specific generate branch is covered in its applicable configuration; every in-scope branch must appear in at least one applicable configuration.
code_coverage.waivers: No code-coverage exclusion is assumed. Any unreachable/illegal point is a coverage hole until proven and separately approved; 100% is not lowered or replaced by an automatic waiver.
code_coverage.source_manifest: verification/plan/active_rtl_source_scope.json; compare third_party candidate sources to exact pinned revisions and finalize classification before G1. Capture the exact run source snapshot and hashes before first credited run. Any RTL/filelist/hash drift after G0 invalidates the frozen plan until reviewed.
code_coverage.third_party_policy: Directory location alone does not establish third-party unchanged status. No locally modified source may be excluded from the 100% project-owned target.

configuration_campaign.top_matrix: All 8 combinations PARA_CPU_NUM={2,4} × PARA_AXI_MEM_DATA_W={32,64,128,256}; elaboration and memory-path smoke for each. Full CPU/software/coherence regression at 2/4 hart × 64-bit baseline; run additional full software cases at other widths if an adapter/top discrepancy is found.
configuration_campaign.reset: Use coordinated reset for cluster, connected AXI fabric/target transaction state and internal coherence agents; backing memory retains contents; no pre-reset response is allowed after release.

evidence_policy.legacy: Existing simulation/lint reports and 58 historical CPU cases are archival context only until cold-replayed against a frozen source snapshot and the new independent checkers.
evidence_policy.replay: One verification/sim/Makefile is the sole public command entry point; each command records exact argv, cwd, environment delta, tool version, timeout, seed, exit status, stdout/stderr, source/input hashes and run ID.
evidence_policy.retention: Never overwrite old evidence. Every testcase, memory model, generated environment component, filelist and root command used in a run is retained under verification/sim.

limitations: No Fmax/area/power/STA signoff: PDK, SRAM views, SDC, PVT and workload constraints are absent.
SoC-dependent global hart-ID assignment and external debug clock/reset/auth policy remain integration dependencies.
The selected PULP AXI4 + AWATOP extension must not be described as AXI4 base or full AXI5.
risk: The strict 100% target includes all 84 active modified upstream modules, including CVA6, HPDcache, LLC and supporting logic. Full architectural/FPU/MMU/exception coverage may be needed; existing 58 directed CPU scenarios alone cannot be assumed sufficient.
